extension.description: Hide your environment variables while screen sharing, streaming or recording. Local-only, never modifies your .env format.
capabilities.untrusted: KayShield only reads and masks environment files locally. It never executes workspace code and never sends data over the network.
view.name: KayShield
view.welcome:
No environment file found in this workspace.
[Scan workspace](command:kayshield.scanWorkspace)
cmd.setDefaultEditor: Use KayShield as Default Editor for .env Files
cmd.clearDefaultEditor: Stop Using KayShield as Default Editor
config.streamerMode: When enabled, every sensitive value stays masked and cannot be revealed until Streamer Mode is turned off.
config.revealTimeout: Time in milliseconds before a revealed value is masked again. Use 0 to keep values revealed until they are hidden manually.
config.maskCharacter: Character used to mask sensitive values.
config.maskPreserveLength: Mask with the same number of characters as the real value. Disabled by default because the length of a secret is itself information.
config.autoDetectSecrets: Automatically score variables and mask the ones detected as sensitive.
config.detectConfigFiles: Also scan JSON, YAML and TOML configuration files for hardcoded secrets.
config.protectEnvExample: Treat .env.example and .env.sample as files containing real secrets.
config.filePatterns: Glob patterns matching the environment files KayShield should handle.
config.secretPatterns: Additional user-defined secret detectors, applied to the variable value or key.
config.ignoredVariables: Variable names (glob patterns allowed) fully ignored by KayShield detection and scanning.
config.alwaysMask: Variable names (glob patterns allowed, e.g. *_TOKEN) that must always be masked.
config.neverMask: Variable names (glob patterns allowed) that must never be masked.
config.maskThreshold: Minimum secret score (0-100) required for a variable to be masked automatically.
config.showStatusBar: Show the KayShield status bar item.
config.scanOnStartup: Run a workspace secret scan when the extension activates.
config.configFileGlobs: Glob patterns of configuration files included in the workspace scan.
